name: Pre-Review Validation
description: Run before declaring a task complete. All items must pass.

items.check: Are all stop conditions from the task prompt verified and passing?
items.fail: One or more stop conditions are not met
items.fix: Re-read Stop Conditions. For each failing condition, apply the described fix and re-verify.

items.check: Does the output comply with all rule IDs referenced in the workflow steps?
items.fail: One or more referenced rules are violated
items.fix: Re-read each workflow step. Verify compliance with every referenced rule ID.

items.check: Does the output violate any constitutional rule from rules/constitution.json?
items.fix: Identify the violated CORE rule. Revert the change and re-implement per constitutional law.

items.check: Have all checklists referenced in the Self-Validation section been executed and passed?
items.fail: One or more checklists have not been run or have failing items
items.fix: Load each referenced checklist. Verify every item passes. Fix failures and re-run.

items.check: Are there any unresolved escalation scenarios from the task's Escalation section?
items.fail: An escalation scenario applies but was not raised
items.fix: Re-read the Escalation section. If a situation matches, stop and ask the prescribed question.

items.check: Have all edge cases from the task's Edge Cases section been reviewed and addressed?
items.pass: All edge cases are reviewed and handled correctly
items.fail: One or more edge cases were not reviewed or are not handled
items.fix: Re-read each edge case. Verify the output handles the described situation. Apply fixes where needed.

items.check: If lazy rules were loaded, are the triggered concerns correctly addressed without violations?
items.pass: All lazy-loaded concerns are correctly addressed
items.fail: A lazy-loaded rule is violated or a triggered concern is not addressed
items.fix: Re-read the loaded lazy rule files. Check the referenced rule IDs. Fix violations.

items.check: Are all notification handlers idempotent? Same payload always produces identical DOM.
items.fail: A notification handler is not idempotent
items.fix: Rewrite the handler to produce identical DOM from identical payload. Remove state-dependent branches.

items.check: Are all mutated state changes undoable? Old values logged before mutation.
items.pass: All mutations are undoable with logged old values
items.fail: A mutation is not undoable or old values are not logged
items.fix: Add old-value logging before every mutation. Verify LIFO reversal within checkpoint boundaries.

items.check: Is hidden game state protected? No private info in public notifications, args, or errors.
items.pass: Hidden information is protected in all paths
items.fail: Hidden information could be exposed in a public path
items.fix: Identify the leak. Split into public/private variants following NOTF-008. Use _private state keys per STAT-006.
